item.description: Jupyter cells have had a stable id since nbformat 4.5 and coding agents already use it, so you can point at a cell by id instead of describing it.

item.title: Spec-Driven Development with AI Agents: Constitutions, Checkpoints, and Handoffs
item.description: How I keep a coding agent on track through a feature that takes days, using a constitution, a frozen plan, review-sized checkpoints and written handoffs.
